name: orgs
title: Organizations
summary: People create organizations, invite others by email or link, let colleagues join by verified email domain, and manage members as owners, admins and members.

env.name: ORGS_DNS_RESOLVER
env.doc: DNS server (host:port) for email-domain verification lookups. Unset = the system resolver.

env.name: ORGS_PUBLIC_EMAIL_DOMAINS
env.doc: Extra public email providers no organization may claim (comma list), added to the built-in list (gmail.com, outlook.com, icloud.com, …).

wire.insert: import { orgsAccountMenu, orgsAdminNav, orgsAutoJoin, orgsSettings } from "./orgs/registry";

stitch: Decide what an organization is called in the product (team, club, workspace) and set it once at module load in the client stitching (web and mobile): configureOrgsNoun({ one: "workspace", many: "workspaces" }). Every orgs screen, settings/admin entry and page title, and the access, files and docs copy, read it; use orgsNoun()/orgsNounTitle()/orgsNounA() in your own copy. Web page titles render on the server: call it from a module the root layout imports too. On the backend call orgs.SetNoun("workspace", "workspaces") from an init in the stitching package: errors, notification kinds and agent tool descriptions read it. API names stay org.
Decide who may create organizations (default: any active account, 10 per hour) and whether a new account must join or create one first.
Scope your own tables and routes to an org: org_id with ON DELETE CASCADE in an app migration, orgs.Require("member"|"admin"|"owner") on an {orgID} URL param, useActiveOrg() on the client.
Set PUBLIC_WEB_URL so invite emails link to /invites/<token> (public on web and mobile; joining resumes after sign-in and consent).
Mobile: configure universal links for PUBLIC_WEB_URL/invites/* if invite emails should open the app (the app route is invites/[token]).

The org switcher sits in the account menu (web) and Settings → Organizations (web and mobile); add OrgSwitcher (web/src/features/orgs) to the top bar if the product is org-centric. If the shell has its own switcher, call setOrgsShellSwitcher(true) at startup so screens drop their in-page pickers (useOrgPickerVisible()).

Email domains: admins and owners claim domains in the org's Domains tab (verified at once by their own email, else by a DNS TXT record; joining people as soon as they open the app needs the DNS record outside development, and a DNS record takes a domain over from an org that holds it only by email). Decide whether only owners should (change Require(RoleAdmin) on the domain routes), and render JoinableOrgs (web and mobile @/features/orgs) on any onboarding screen for people without an org.
Add the regional free-mail providers your users have to ORGS_PUBLIC_EMAIL_DOMAINS; set ORGS_DNS_RESOLVER if the server's resolver can't see public DNS (split-horizon networks).
